acceptanceCriteria: Git and overlay identities are distinct and test-covered; unsaved text cannot be labelled committed proof.
Edits, saves, close/reopen, rename, branch/root changes and out-of-order responses invalidate stale results without losing unrelated committed evidence.
Facts carry provenance and inclusion reason; dedupe/conflict handling preserves project-owned authority, does not invent cross-language links, and never silently changes Core ranking or learning.
Bounded conformance and focused resource tests compare CLI/MCP and editor projections on the same admitted snapshot.
body:
Parent V1-0477. Implement the shared snapshot and evidence-join engine for Git-pinned agent reads and live editor overlays. Preserve authority, boundedness and explicit conflict/uncertainty.

2026-09-29 experimental component progress: snapshot candidate532e8ea5ba22509064ef2e0a6ef8eadfbcecd485 separates syntactically validated Git identities from immutable captured overlays. Focused race/vet/spec checks pass. Independent review found caller-backed memory retention; reproduced and repaired with owned strings, then re-review passed. No filesystem/Git existence verification or automatic branch/save detection; callers must signal invalidation. Shared Core evidence joins, integrated conformance, final CEM and native completion remain pending.
title: LSP quality: share immutable and editor-overlay evidence
